entries.en: to retire to the privy (polite euphemism for relieving oneself)

entries.en: to move about, to act; movement, action, conduct

as the proverb says; the proverb goes

entries.en: set phrase, stock saying; formulaic expression

entries.en: old saying, ancient proverb; archaic expression

entries.en: common saying, vernacular proverb; idem (same as above)

entries.zh: 俗话；俗语（民间常言，义同上条）
圣；神圣（疑指天主圣意、上智安排）
entries.en: Providence (divine providence, God's holy will); holy
entries.notes: 西语 Providencia（天主上智、圣意）与单字「圣」非直接对译，疑为省文或四栏错位。

entries.zh: 灵圣；神明灵验、神圣灵异（指天主上智之灵佑）
entries.en: divine Providence; numinous efficacy, holy spiritual power

entries.zh: 国策；治国方略（对国家公共事务的远见与审慎）
entries.en: state policy; prudence and foresight in public (common) affairs

entries.zh: 注定；命中注定、天定（天主上智之预定）
entries.en: predestined, fated by God; divine providence and determination

entries.zh: 广；宽广、幅员（疑为广东等省之省称）
entries.en: province (perh. abbreviated name of a province such as Guangdong); breadth, extent
entries.notes: 西语 provincia（省）与单字「广」无直接对应，疑为省名略字或承下条 provincia maritima 之省文。
